integrity: Analytic interval-covering proof, exact rational exponential bounds and uniform Parry-edge expansion. Reproducible script checks finite representative cases and exact rational inequalities; no external independent scientific audit.
limitations: Explicit sufficient, not sharp, parameter cutoff; one specified repeller rather than global attractor; Lyapunov expansion is for its unique Parry measure only; no full-map entropy equality or typical-attraction claim.
title: An effective golden-mean repeller and its Lyapunov law in a replicator family
